gitCommit.subject: Public build for tsxmr.com: VITE_SITE_SURFACE=public, without the API, the account or the console
gitCommit.body:
Public build for tsxmr.com: VITE_SITE_SURFACE=public, without the API, the account or the console

The owner's brief of 2026-10-17: publish the public site at https://tsxmr.com
while the business account (later https://dukan.tsxmr.com) and the API
(later https://api.tsxmr.com) stay separate. As built, the site needed the
API on its own origin: /apply, /login, /application-status and the Dukan ERP
prices call it, and /account and /admin ship in the same bundle.

VITE_SITE_SURFACE=public (default full: nothing changes otherwise):
- the three pages that need the API are not built, linked, prerendered or
  listed in the sitemap; /account and /admin are not rewritten (404), and a
  build alias replaces their routes with a stub, so neither area's code is
  in the bundle;
- VITE_API_BASE is not asked for, the CSP allows no API origin, no request
  leaves the page;
- "Sign in" and "Apply" link to VITE_PORTAL_ORIGIN once one is given and
  are absent before; the Dukan ERP page shows no prices and says to ask
  (EN/FR/AR);
- every other refusal of a production build stands: blank facts, test
  values, legal blockers and drafts.

Tests: site-surface (release rule, routes, sitemap, headers, rewrites,
links) and site-surface-render (EN/FR/AR pages, unknown /account, /admin,
/apply). CI builds and audits the public surface too (refusal without the
API, preview, links, bundle --public). .node-version pins Node 22 for
Cloudflare Pages.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
